build_competitions_package: build a python package for Hugging Face Competitions using setuptools and find_packages
install_competitions_dev: install the competitions package with dev extras including black isort flake8 and mypy
install_competitions_test: install the competitions package with test extras including pytest and pytest-cov
install_competitions_docs: install the competitions package with docs extras including hf-doc-builder for documentation
run_competitions_cli: run the competitions console script entry point from competitions.cli.competitions main function
